title: Legal, empirical, and normative claims are not the same
japanese_title: 法的主張・政策効果・価値判断の分離
summary: A legal finding is separated from effectiveness and ethical desirability.
user_input: A court found Policy X legal in a specific jurisdiction and legal context. That legal finding should be separated from empirical claims about policy effectiveness and normative claims about whether the policy is ethically desirable.
reason_for_tier: B-tier because legal validity is scoped, while empirical and normative claims require separate evidence.
audit_notes: The case uses three separated hypotheses rather than one blended truth claim.
key_warning_theme: Jurisdiction, legal authority, outcome measure, and value premise must stay explicit.
